about.title: About MileTax
about.body: MileTax helps self-employed workers record vehicles, mileage, receipts and income, then prepare a package for their accountant. The app does not file tax returns and does not provide tax advice.

privacySections.heading: Who we are
privacySections.body: MileTax is a mobile app that helps self-employed workers organize records (vehicles, mileage, receipts, expenses, income) for their accountant. It is not tax software and does not replace a professional. Contact: support@miletax.app.

privacySections.heading: Data we collect
privacySections.body: We collect account email, profile (name, country, province or state, occupation, units), vehicles, odometer readings, meter photos, receipts, amounts and categories you enter, income, preparatory packages, and correction logs you confirm. We do not sell your data.

privacySections.heading: Photos and automated reading
privacySections.body: Receipt and odometer photos are stored in a private space tied to your account. Automated reading (on-device or, if configured, an OCR service) suggests fields. These are suggestions: nothing is saved as an expense or reading until you confirm. Do not photograph identity documents.

privacySections.heading: Use and retention
privacySections.body: Data is used to sign you in, organize your records, and build the accountant package. It is kept while the account exists. You can export a JSON copy and delete the account, which removes records and associated photos.

privacySections.heading: Sharing
privacySections.body: Your records remain yours. The accountant name and email you enter do not trigger automatic sending. If you share a PDF, you send it. Hosting processors (Supabase) handle data to operate the service, limited to the authenticated account (RLS).

privacySections.heading: Your rights
privacySections.body: Under PIPEDA and, in Quebec, Law 25, you may access, correct, and obtain a copy of your information, and delete the account in the app. For a written request: support@miletax.app.

privacySections.heading: Children
privacySections.body: MileTax is for self-employed workers. It is not intended for children under 13 (or the applicable digital age in your region).

termsSections.heading: Service
termsSections.body: MileTax organizes your business records and prepares a package for your accountant. It does not file tax returns, compute tax, or provide legal or tax advice.

termsSections.heading: Accuracy
termsSections.body: You are responsible for the amounts, dates, categories and readings you confirm. Displayed totals are sums of what you entered, not a tax figure. OCR suggestions must be reviewed before saving.

termsSections.heading: Account
termsSections.body: You must provide a valid email and protect your password. You may export your data and delete the account at any time. After deletion, records cannot be recovered.

termsSections.heading: Acceptable use
termsSections.body: Do not use the app for illegal purposes, identity fraud, or uploads you have no right to store. Photos must relate to your business activity.

termsSections.heading: Limitation of liability
termsSections.body: To the extent permitted by law, MileTax is not liable for losses related to a tax filing, a penalty, a miscategorized item, or an OCR reading you did not correct. Keep your originals.

termsSections.heading: Governing law
termsSections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Quebec and Canada. Quebec courts have jurisdiction, subject to mandatory consumer-protection rights.
